description: Add or remove network intercept rules. Block requests (ads, trackers), mock API responses, or log specific traffic. Use action='remove' with ruleId to remove an existing rule.

mockContentType.description: Content-type for mock responses. Default: application/json.

ruleId.description: Unique rule ID. Use for adding and removing rules.

urlPattern.description: URL glob pattern to match (e.g. '**/analytics/**'). Required for block/log/mock.

name: network_intercept
title: Network Intercept
